purpose: Bind Stream 1 artistic sound decisions to exact frozen Program locations without encoding engine implementation details.

authority_rules.locator_basis: one-based Program segment index plus exact speaker/text guard
authority_rules.timing_policy: Stream 1 defines narrative placement and bounded carry. Stream 3 derives concrete milliseconds from real assets/runtime.

after.speaker: NARRATRICE
after.text: Puis Poséidon voit l’homme qui lui a échappé trop longtemps.

before.speaker: NARRATRICE
before.text: Le ciel se ferme. Le vent arrive de plusieurs côtés à la fois. L’embarcation cesse d’être une construction et devient une question : combien de temps peut-elle encore tenir ?

directives.artistic_intent: The storm must arrive as an event before narration fully explains it; it may briefly pressure the speech but must not become a generic sea bed.
directives.fallback: omit-and-warn if no qualified wind asset

directives.artistic_intent: A single brief wood-failure punctuation may prefigure the narrated break. Do not illustrate every action.

starts_at.speaker: ULYSSE
starts_at.text: Il a poussé devant l’entrée une pierre que douze hommes n’auraient pas déplacée.

directives.artistic_intent: Confinement is carried by P3 voice mass, rhythm, spatial restraint and silence. A library stone impact is not required.

after.speaker: ULYSSE
after.text: Je me suis réveillé quand le bateau a changé sous mon corps.

before.speaker: ULYSSE
before.text: On sent le vent avant même de l’entendre. Le bois n’appuie plus au même endroit. La voile tire autrement.

directives.artistic_intent: The listener should feel the released winds before the explanation catches up. The event then disappears; it must not become voyage ambience.
directives.fallback: omit-and-warn if no qualified wind asset

before.speaker: ULYSSE
before.text: Les autres n’ont pas eu le temps de sortir.

directives.artistic_intent: Use at most one compressed wood-under-stress punctuation. The real consequence is heard afterwards through reduced ensemble density and the words 'J’avais un bateau.'

starts_at.speaker: ULYSSE
starts_at.text: Je ne peux pas décrire le pays des morts comme une île.

directives.artistic_intent: Strangeness by subtraction. Preserve the exact human-accepted P5 dark-air layer and no other atmospheric layer.
directives.fallback: fail-closed; do not silently replace accepted P5 recipe

materialization_status.rule: P5 remains closed artistically; do not reopen the accepted recipe.

directives.artistic_intent: The bow/string event is the privileged physical punctuation. It should tell the action a fraction before narration confirms it.

starts_at.speaker: NARRATRICE
starts_at.text: Le combat n’a rien d’un chant.

ends_at.speaker: NARRATRICE
ends_at.text: Et puis, aussi brutalement qu’elle a commencé, la lutte s’arrête.

directives.artistic_intent: Violence is short, close and legible. Voices and narration carry it; no catalogue of impacts is required.

after.speaker: NARRATRICE
after.text: Et puis, aussi brutalement qu’elle a commencé, la lutte s’arrête.

directives.artistic_intent: Drop sound density sharply after action so S15 can become the emotional climax without music.

validation_contract: Every locator speaker/text must match its bound Program blob before materialization.
If a bound Program blob changes, Stream 3 must fail closed and return the mismatch to Stream 1.
No fuzzy matching or nearest-line substitution.
Concrete gain, fade and millisecond values are Stream 3 implementation details, constrained by the artistic intent above.
No sound is preferable to a weak, clichéd, unlicensed or narratively redundant asset.

current_materialization_evidence.rule: Explicit silence/no-selection outcomes remain valid sound-direction materialization; no manual asset search or lower threshold is authorized.
